claim_text: This section does not cover animal brush-making bristles or hair (heading 0502); horsehair or horsehair waste (heading 0511).
extraction_notes: Clause (a) of Section XI Note 1.

claim_text: For the purposes of this section, the expression 'made up' means: a. cut otherwise than into squares or rectangles; b. produced in the finished state, ready for use; c. cut to size with at least one heat-sealed edge; d. hemmed or with rolled edges; e. cut to size and having undergone drawn thread work; f. assembled by sewing, gumming or otherwise; g. knitted or crocheted to shape.
extraction_notes: Definition of 'made up' for textiles — boolean field in O2 schema (made_up).

claim_text: Ch.25 covers only products in crude state or washed, crushed, ground, powdered, levigated, sifted, screened, concentrated by flotation, magnetic separation or other mechanical/physical processes (except crystallization), but not products that have been roasted, calcined, obtained by mixing or subjected to processing beyond that mentioned in each heading.
extraction_notes: Note 1 — critical processing-state filter for Ch.25.

claim_text: Heading 2844 applies only to: (a) technetium, promethium, polonium and all elements with atomic number greater than 84; (b) natural or artificial radioactive isotopes; (c) compounds of these elements; (d) alloys/ceramics having specific radioactivity exceeding 74 Bq/g; (e) spent (irradiated) fuel elements; (f) radioactive residues.
extraction_notes: Definitive scoping of h.2844 — must be radioactive.

claim_text: This section does not cover human hair or articles of human hair (heading 0501, 6703 or 6704), except filtering or straining cloth of a kind commonly used in oil-presses or the like (heading 5911).
extraction_notes: Clause (b) Section XI Note 1; uses candidate.heading carve-out for 5911.

claim_text: Throughout this Schedule, the expression "base metals" means: iron and steel, copper, nickel, aluminium, lead, zinc, tin, tungsten (wolfram), molybdenum, tantalum, magnesium, cobalt, bismuth, cadmium, titanium, zirconium, antimony, manganese, beryllium, chromium, germanium, vanadium, gallium, hafnium, indium, niobium (columbium), rhenium and thallium.
extraction_notes: Definitive enumeration of base metals — applies to any tariff line in Section XV.

claim_text: Except where the context otherwise requires, the headings of this Chapter apply only to: (a) separate chemically defined organic compounds, whether or not containing impurities; (b) mixtures of two or more isomers of the same organic compound.
extraction_notes: Note 1(a)+(b).

claim_text: Heading 5903 applies to textile fabrics, impregnated, coated, covered or laminated with plastics.
extraction_notes: h.5903 scope.

claim_text: This section does not cover cotton linters or other vegetable materials of Chapter 14.
extraction_notes: Clause (c) Section XI Note 1.

claim_text: Classification of alloys (other than ferro-alloys and master alloys as defined in Chapters 72 and 74): (a) an alloy of base metals is to be classified as an alloy of the metal which predominates by weight over each of the other metals.
extraction_notes: Predominance rule — O2 must materialize predominant_element. Verifier asserts presence.

claim_text: This Chapter applies only to made up knitted or crocheted articles.
extraction_notes: Ch.61 scope: knitted/crocheted + made_up. Uses fabric_construction + made_up O2 fields.

claim_text: All articles consisting wholly or partly: (a) of natural or cultured pearls or of precious or of semi-precious stones; or (b) of precious metal or of metal clad with precious metal, are to be classified in this Chapter.
extraction_notes: Note 1 — Ch.71 scope inclusion.

claim_text: This section does not cover asbestos of heading 2524 or articles of asbestos or other products of heading 6812 or 6813.
extraction_notes: Clause (d).

claim_text: (b) Powders: products of which 90% or more by weight passes through a sieve having a mesh aperture of 1 mm.
extraction_notes: Numeric definition — uses sieve_pass_pct_1mm O2 field per sub-spec 04.

claim_text: This Chapter applies only to made up articles of any textile fabric other than wadding, excluding knitted or crocheted (other than those of heading 6212).
extraction_notes: KEY rule per sub-spec 04: Ch.62 = made-up textile that is NOT knitted/crocheted OR is h.6212. Uses candidate.heading carve-out.

claim_text: Heading 8712 includes all children's bicycles. Other children's cycles fall in heading 9503.
extraction_notes: Children's bicycles disambiguation.

claim_text: This section does not cover hides or skins with their hair or wool on (Chapter 41 or 43) or articles of furskin, artificial fur or articles thereof, of heading 4303 or 4304.
extraction_notes: Clause (k). Multiple chapter+heading redirect.

claim_text: Throughout this Schedule, elephant, hippopotamus, walrus, narwhal and wild boar tusks, rhinoceros horns and the teeth of all animals are regarded as "ivory".
extraction_notes: Definition: all these items materialize as ivory.

claim_text: This Chapter applies only to ceramic products which have been fired after shaping.
extraction_notes: Ch.69 scope condition.

claim_text: Heading 6212 is the sole heading in Chapter 62 that may cover knitted or crocheted articles (per Chapter Note 1). Brassieres, girdles, corsets etc. are classified here whether or not knitted or crocheted.
extraction_notes: h.6212 is the knitted-allowed exception in Ch.62 — critical carve-out per sub-spec 04.

claim_text: In this Section, the term "pellets" means products which have been agglomerated either directly by compression or by the addition of a binder in a proportion not exceeding 3 (percent) by weight.
extraction_notes: Definition of 'pellets' for Section II. Numeric 3% binder threshold dropped (no binder_pct field in O2 schema); processing_state values are proposed enums.

claim_text: Except for the goods of heading 3918 or 3919, plastics, rubber, and articles thereof, printed with motifs, characters or pictorial representations, which are not merely subsidiary to the primary use of the goods, fall in Chapter 49.
extraction_notes: Carve-out via candidate.heading; 'not merely subsidiary' qualifier is SKIP-purposive but the redirect is honoured.

claim_text: This section does not cover monofilament of which any cross-sectional dimension exceeds 1 mm or strip or the like (for example, artificial straw) of an apparent width exceeding 5 mm, of plastics (Chapter 39).
extraction_notes: Clause (g). Cross-section >1mm numeric not in O2 schema — predicate captures form+material only; verifier SKIPs on cross_section_mm.

claim_text: The products specified in the headings of this Chapter are to be classified in those headings only if grains are present, whether or not in the ear or on the stalk. Ch.10 does not cover grains which have been hulled or otherwise worked.
extraction_notes: Carve-out: rice (h.1006) and quinoa (h.1008) explicitly excepted in note; predicate captures the primary rule only.

claim_text: Heading 1207 applies, inter alia, to palm nuts and kernels, cotton seeds, castor oil seeds, sesamum seeds, mustard seeds, safflower seeds, poppy seeds and shea nuts (karite nuts).
extraction_notes: Inclusion enumeration for h.1207. Not exhaustive ('inter alia').

claim_text: In this Section, the term "pellets" means products which have been agglomerated either directly by compression or by the addition of a binder in a proportion not exceeding 3 (percent) by weight.
extraction_notes: Mirror of Section II Note 1 — identical text but applies to Section IV chapters.

claim_text: Except for the goods of heading 4814 or 4821, paper, paperboard, cellulose wadding and articles thereof, printed with motifs, characters or pictorial representations, which are not merely subsidiary to the primary use of the goods, fall in Chapter 49.
extraction_notes: Carve-out for printed paper. 'not merely subsidiary' is SKIP-purposive but predicate captures the substantive.

claim_text: This section does not cover glass fibres or articles of glass fibres, other than embroidery with glass thread on a visible ground of fabric (Chapter 70).
extraction_notes: Clause (r) — carve-out for embroidery with glass thread on visible ground.

claim_text: Tomato juice, the dry weight content of which is 7% or more is to be classified in heading 2002.
extraction_notes: dry_weight_pct missing in O2 (DSL-gap-deferred).

claim_text: Goods classifiable in Chapters 50 to 55 or in heading 5809 or 5902 and of a mixture of two or more textile materials are to be classified as if consisting wholly of that one textile material which predominates by weight over any other single textile material.
extraction_notes: Mixture-predominance rule for Chapters 50-55. Asserts that for any tariff_line in these chapters, predominant_element must be extractable. Verifier checks O2 populated it.

claim_text: This Section does not cover prepared paints, inks or other products with a basis of metallic flakes or powder (headings 3207 to 3210, 3212, 3213 or 3215).
extraction_notes: Clause (a). Multi-heading redirect.

claim_text: Except where the context otherwise requires, the headings of this Chapter apply only to: (a) separate chemical elements and separate chemically defined compounds, whether or not containing impurities; (b) the products mentioned in (a) above dissolved in water.
extraction_notes: Lead clause (a)+(b) of Note 1. chemical_class enum extension needed for 'separate_inorganic_compound' (not currently in sub-spec 04 list — flagged in extraction-log).

claim_text: (a) Throughout the Nomenclature, the expression "electrical and electronic waste and scrap" means electrical and electronic assemblies, printed circuit boards and electrical or electronic articles that (i) have been rendered unusable for their original purposes by breakage, cutting-up or other processes or are economically unsuitable for repair, refurbishment or renovation; and (ii) are packaged or shipped in a manner not intended to protect individual articles from damage. (b) mixed consignments of such waste and other waste are to be classified in heading 8549.
extraction_notes: Definition of e-waste. processing_state enum value for e-waste.

claim_text: This Section does not cover transmission or conveyor belts or belting, of plastics of Chapter 39, or of vulcanised rubber (heading 4010), or other articles of a kind used in machinery or mechanical or electrical appliances or for other technical uses, of vulcanised rubber other than hard rubber (heading 4016).
extraction_notes: Clause (a) Section XVI Note 1.

claim_text: Ch.28 covers products dissolved in solvents (other than water) provided that the solution constitutes a normal and necessary method of putting up these products adopted solely for reasons of safety or for transport.
extraction_notes: Uses in_solution + solution_purpose enums per sub-spec 04. solution_purpose is high-SKIP-risk per sub-spec.

claim_text: For the purposes of heading 0405: the term "butter" means natural butter, whey butter or recombined butter derived exclusively from milk, with a milkfat content of 80% or more but not more than 95% by weight.
extraction_notes: Numeric composition: milkfat_pct is NOT in current O2 schema. Predicate emitted; verifier SKIPs until O2 adds milkfat_pct (DSL-gap-deferred-to-O2).

claim_text: Ch.01 does not cover animals of heading 9508.
extraction_notes: Clause (c) — h.9508 covers circus/zoo animals.

claim_text: Heading 6309 applies only to textile-material clothing, blankets, bed linen, furnishing articles, footwear and headgear that show signs of appreciable wear and are presented in bulk or in bales.
extraction_notes: h.6309 scope. form='bulk_packed' is proposed enum.

claim_text: For the purposes of heading 2009, 'juices, unfermented and not containing added spirit' means juices of an alcoholic strength by volume not exceeding 0.5% volume.
extraction_notes: alcoholic_strength_pct missing in O2 (DSL-gap-deferred).

claim_text: Ch.03 does not cover meat of mammals of heading 0106 (heading 0208 or 0210).
extraction_notes: Clause (b).

claim_text: Any reference in this Section to a particular genus or species of an animal, except where the context otherwise requires, includes a reference to the young of that genus or species.
extraction_notes: SKIP-RECOMMENDED: pure interpretive rule about scope of references; not encodable as a per-tariff-line predicate. Retained for citation auditing.

claim_text: (A) Goods (other than radioactive ores) answering to a description in heading 2844 or 2845 are to be classified in those headings and in no other heading of this Schedule. (B) Subject to paragraph (A) above, goods answering to a description in heading 2843, 2846 or 2852 are to be classified in those headings and in no other heading of this Section.
extraction_notes: Cross-heading priority rule; not a per-tariff-line predicate but a classification meta-rule. SKIP marker; metadata preserved for repair_feedback.

claim_text: Goods put up in sets consisting of two or more separate constituents, some or all of which fall in this Section and are intended to be mixed together to obtain a product of Section VI or VII, are to be classified in the heading appropriate to that product.
extraction_notes: SKIP-PURPOSIVE: 'intended to be mixed together' — intent reasoning. Composite-set rule handled by GIR-3 verifier path.

claim_text: Ch.16 does not cover meat, meat offal, fish, crustaceans, molluscs or other aquatic invertebrates, as well as insects, prepared or preserved by the processes specified in Chapter 2 or 3.
extraction_notes: SKIP: process-specific reference to processes in another chapter; cannot encode 'processed by Ch.2/3 specific processes' without process_type enum.

claim_text: Except where the context otherwise requires, throughout this Schedule, any reference to "dried" products also covers products which have been dehydrated, evaporated or freeze-dried.
extraction_notes: SKIP-RECOMMENDED: definitional expansion of 'dried' across schedule; not per-line predicate.

claim_text: Subject to Note 1 above, goods classifiable in heading 3004, 3005, 3006, 3212, 3303, 3304, 3305, 3306, 3307, 3506, 3707 or 3808 by reason of being put up in measured doses or for retail sale are to be classified in those headings and in no other heading of this Schedule.
extraction_notes: Retail-packaging priority rule. SKIP-purposive: 'by reason of being put up in measured doses or for retail sale'. Metadata kept for repair.

claim_text: Goods put up in sets consisting of two or more separate constituents, some or all of which fall in this Section and are intended to be mixed together to obtain a product of Section VI or VII, are to be classified in the heading appropriate to that product.
extraction_notes: Mirror of Section VI Note 3. Same SKIP-purposive treatment.

claim_text: Ch.18 does not cover food preparations containing more than 20% by weight of sausage, meat, fish or seafood (Chapter 16).
extraction_notes: meat_seafood_pct field missing (O2 gap).

claim_text: Throughout this Schedule, the expression "parts of general use" means: (a) articles of heading 7307, 7312, 7315, 7317 or 7318 and similar articles of other base metal, other than articles specially designed for use exclusively in implants in medical, surgical, dental or veterinary sciences (heading 9021); (b) springs and leaves for springs, of base metal, other than clock or watch springs (heading 9114); and (c) articles of headings 8301, 8302, 8308, 8310 and frames and mirrors, of base metal, of heading 8306.
extraction_notes: SKIP: pure definitional scoping clause. Drives downstream parts-classification rules; not a per-line predicate.

claim_text: Where a product answers to a description in one or more of the headings in Section VI by virtue of being described by name or function and also to heading 3827, then it is classifiable in a heading that references the product by name or function and not under heading 3827.
extraction_notes: Heading 3827 specificity carve-out — meta-rule, not per-line. SKIP marker; metadata preserved.
